summary: Supports thoughtful boundaries around screen use and safeguards for students, opposes broad screen-time restrictions.

claims.argument: Screen-time limits could unintentionally limit access to tools students rely on for communication, accessibility, and instruction.
claims.evidence_quote: Any requirements concerning screen time or educational technology should preserve flexibility for educators to meet those needs. Broad restrictions could unintentionally limit access to tools students rely on for communication, accessibility, and instruction.
